a2a2a_message.action_requested: Orchestrator True Cleanup — Build Artifact Removal + .gitignore Hardening

context.goal: The '7083 files' panic from the refactor plan is MISDIAGNOSED. Verified findings: services/orchestrator has 7083 files total, but 7025 are Rust target/ build artifacts (1.3GB). Only 41 actual source files exist (7 Rust crates + TS/Python bridge files). The source is already lean. The real task is: (1) Add/verify .gitignore entries for target/, build/, node_modules/ in services/orchestrator/ so build artifacts never get committed. (2) Delete the 1.3GB target/ directory to reclaim disk. (3) Verify the 41 source files are coherent Rust workspace code (crates: hermes-core, hermes-router, hermes-dispatch, hermes-worker, hermes-feed, hermes-lock, hermes-governance). (4) Produce a file-count before/after report.
constraints: DO NOT delete source .rs/.ts/.py files without verification
Run cargo clean or rm -rf target/ to reclaim disk
Report file count before and after
deliverables: Confirmation that 41 source files are intact and cargo workspace compiles (dry-run: cargo check)

tier_rationale: Tier A: Read-only analysis + build-artifact cleanup only. No source modification, no deploy, no push. Fully reversible (target/ regenerates via cargo build).
